async def policy_in_force(tenant_id, db=None):
    """What a ledger entry records about the guardrail policy."""
    try:
        policy = await load_policy(tenant_id, db=db)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - the decision is still recorded; the entry says the policy was unreadable
        logger.warning("guardrail policy unreadable while writing a ledger entry", exc_info=True)
        return {"status": "unreadable", "sha256": None}
    if policy is None:
        return {"status": "none", "sha256": None}
    return {"status": "in_force", "sha256": policy_sha256(policy)}
